title: AuthBench v2.1.0: temporally leak-free, alert-budget evaluation of authentication anomaly detectors
description:
AuthBench is an open harness that evaluates authentication anomaly detectors under a temporally leak-free protocol and daily alert budgets. It checks the temporal order of its partitions, tests that every detector scores an event identically alone or among others, ranks events, edge-hours and user-days within each day, gives every red-team campaign the daily budget at which it is first detected, and sets each result against its exact distribution under a random ranking and against label-free activity rankings of the same units.

Version 2.1.0 is the code of version 2 of the report (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23588166). Over 2.0.0 it adds the label-free user-day activity rankings and the aggregation-aware null (scripts/user_day_activity.py, checked by the generator against the run on every day), the temporal-order guard on the LANL training path, integration tests of the entry points that produced the run, refusal of feature settings the pipeline would ignore, a third round of review with its response, and the answer of Euler's first author, with the configuration of the authors'-code runs read into the report. The run outputs of 22 October 2026 are unchanged.

Behaviour change: build_features refuses feature settings it does not implement, instead of ignoring them.
